message: The other day, we had a little storm warning, and you know what that means—cue the family group chat! 💬 My phone was buzzing with everyone’s go-bag checklists and water supply updates. It felt nice to share the responsibility, and I loved how it turned into a mini brainstorming session on what snacks to pack! It reminded me that being prepared doesn’t have to be a solo mission; it can bring us together. How do you and your family stay connected when preparing for the unexpected?
